Class CorporateClient

java.lang.Object
Business.Entities.CorporateClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
Customer
public class CorporateClient extends Object implements Customer
Represents a corporate (B2B) client in the system. Extends the Customer contract with a tax identification number (NIF), a contact person name, a billing address, and a shipping address.

VAT handling for corporate clients depends on the billing address country: companies with a billing address outside Spain are exempt from VAT and therefore use a pricing strategy multiplier of 1.0 (no VAT applied). Companies billed within Spain pay the standard 21% VAT, represented by a multiplier of 1.21.

Corporate clients cannot purchase Service products, as services require the customer to be physically present at the store.

  • Method Details

    • getPricingStrategy

      public double getPricingStrategy()
      Returns the VAT multiplier for this corporate client.

      Companies with a billing address outside Spain are VAT-exempt: multiplier 1.0. All other companies pay the standard 21% VAT: multiplier 1.21.

      This value is applied directly to the provider's base selling price by calculateFinalPrice(Product, double) — it is NOT layered on top of a product VAT calculation.

      Specified by:
      getPricingStrategy in interface Customer
      Returns:
      1.0 for VAT-exempt companies, 1.21 for Spanish companies

    • calculateFinalPrice

      public double calculateFinalPrice(Product product, double sellingPrice)
      Calculates the final price for a corporate client by applying the VAT multiplier directly to the provider's base selling price — bypassing the product's own Product.calculatePrice(double) so that product-specific VAT rates do not compound with the corporate VAT rule.
      • Spain: sellingPrice × 1.21 (standard 21% VAT)
      • Outside Spain: sellingPrice × 1.0 (VAT-exempt, base price only)
      Specified by:
      calculateFinalPrice in interface Customer
      Parameters:
      product - the product being purchased (not used for price calculation)
      sellingPrice - the provider's base selling price before tax
      Returns:
      the final price this corporate client pays
